summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through the Quadrature Nexus and FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, then analyzing those journeys via Ouroboros and Mycelium to feed synthesized patterns back into the system as a closed loop. Then scale the system into an overnight autoresearch loop running indefinitely.
summary.outcome: Wired FLUME 256D encoding into Quadrature Nexus (E1-E6), built a continuously-running autoresearch loop accumulating 40,000+ experiment runs, discovered and committed a production bug fix in `apply_mycelium_feedback` (SET → additive calibration), validated the full closed-loop pipeline E55–E64, added proper experimental methodology with retirement criterion, and opened PR #113 with all session improvements.

repo: SurrealDB requires `RETURN true;` for connection probing — `SELECT 1;` returns HTTP 400 in this SurrealQL version
SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables reject arbitrary nested subfields in TYPE object columns; variable data must go into an `option<string>` field as JSON
SurrealDB datetime fields require `time::now()` function, not ISO string literals

`run_llm_deliberation()` unconditionally SETs `_score_adjustments[vt]` on every call, wiping any Mycelium calibration from the previous cycle — this was the root cause of all E5/E6 failures across the session

Two-layer calibration model: `_mycelium_calibration` (accumulative, preserved across deliberations) vs `_score_adjustments` (overwritten each call to `run_llm_deliberation`) must be kept separate for any experiment that modifies voice scoring

Lemonade iGPU ROCm can enter a silent failure state where all evaluation prompts return empty strings but arithmetic prompts still work — the correct probe is `2+2=` not `/models` endpoint availability
The convergence formula for Mycelium compounding is exact: `consensus_n = threshold − gap_0 × (1 − lr/2)^n`, validated to max_error=0.00025
The SCHEDULE labels in `overnight_evo_loop.py` must exactly match the `experiment=` string passed to `log_result` — a mismatch silently breaks the retirement criterion
Gemini worktrees can be cleaned up by the tooling at any time; code in `.gemini/worktrees/` is ephemeral and must be committed to survive
`string::starts_with` function does not exist in the installed SurrealDB version; use exact match or `string::contains` instead
Pre-commit hooks with `pass_filenames: false` can be scoped with a `files:` pattern — without it, hooks like Playwright run unconditionally on every commit regardless of what changed

code.finding: apply_mycelium_feedback() used SET semantics (`_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment`) causing cycle 2 to replace cycle 1's calibration with a smaller value (decay). Fixed to additive: `_mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; _score_adjustments[vt] = _mycelium_calibration[vt]`. Also required adding `_mycelium_calibration: dict[VoiceType, float] = dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0)` to `__init__`.

_evaluate_resource() originally only checked `budget_available` context flag — it was entirely insensitive to proposal description text. Extended with keyword check for ('cost', 'budget', 'efficient', 'resource', 'reduce') giving +0.10 bonus to match the other voice heuristics.

run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally overwrites _score_adjustments[vt] = (voice_scores - base) + mycelium_calib on every deliberation. Any profile experiment (E47) that modifies _score_adjustments will have changes wiped — must modify _mycelium_calibration instead.
Pre-existing F841 unused variable lint error in E8 experiment code. Also at line 1223 in E46 code.

Was entirely simulated — connect() returned True without any HTTP call. Full rewrite to use httpx with real HTTP POST to `http://127.0.0.1:8001/sql`. All three CREATE journey_point calls required `metadata = {}` and `timestamp = time::now()` to satisfy SCHEMAFULL constraints.

New test file with 11 tests validating E55-E62 findings. The synthesized skill helper must use the `_synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill` output format (`architect: mean_score=X.XXXX`), not the `ingest_evo_journeys` input format (`voice_scores=[...]`). All 11 tests pass.

workflow: timeit.default_timer() is the correct high-resolution timer for experiment wall-clock measurement — unaffected by NTP corrections unlike time.time()

Retirement criterion pattern: track keep metrics per experiment label; retire when CV of last 10 keeps < 0.05 AND n_keeps >= 20 (converged attractor) OR keep_frac == 0 AND n_runs >= min_runs (confirmed noise)
V-model pre-specification prevents wasted iterations: E50 ran 17 iterations on a broken metric, E54 needed 3 redesigns because the metric was never proven achievable before running
Floating-point threshold comparison: `sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85` in IEEE 754 — `result.approved` (direct comparison against class constant) is the authoritative threshold crossing check, not float mean
When a PR branch is 200+ commits behind its target, test mergeability with `git merge-tree` rather than attempting interactive rebase — replay conflicts can corrupt lint-only patches
Experiments sharing a nexus instance contaminate each other through `_mycelium_calibration` and `_score_adjustments` — properly sandboxed experiments require a fresh `QuadratureNexus()` per run

JEPA world model needs distributional diversity to learn; a single-attractor heuristic mode produces identical 12D state vectors every run and catastrophic forgetting erases gains between sessions regardless of replay buffer size

friction: Gemini worktree `.gemini/worktrees/2026-05-02-03-57-33-561-fvqr/` was silently cleaned up, destroying the 3500-line version of overnight_evo_loop.py containing E55-E64 experiments — required full reimplementation from scratch

Pre-commit hook runs Playwright tests unconditionally on every commit (no `files:` filter), requiring a Next.js server at localhost:3000 that is never running during autoresearch sessions — caused repeated commit failures
pyproject.toml had unresolved 3-way merge conflicts that blocked `uv run` entirely — had to be manually resolved before the loop could restart
An interactive rebase started by another process (`polish/context-graceful-load`) left `.git/rebase-merge/` state that conflicted with branch operations mid-session
Multiple overnight loop processes accumulated over session restarts due to SIGTERM not propagating to child processes, eventually exhausting 39GB swap and requiring force kills
Lemonade iGPU ROCm entered silent failure mode: evaluation prompts return empty strings but arithmetic works — no visible error, only discovered when DB record count stopped growing

SCHEDULE labels (`E55_mycelium`) didn't match experiment name strings (`E55`) passed to log_result, causing retirement criterion to silently never fire — ran thousands of converged iterations unnecessarily
SurrealDB `journey_point` table SCHEMAFULL definition silently rejected `metadata` subfields, causing inserts to return success responses while writing nothing — took 4 debug iterations to discover
ruff formatter kept removing manually-added global variables and function definitions during pre-commit reformatting passes, requiring multiple re-insertions of the same code
open_items: apply_mycelium_feedback() has zero production callers in src/ — the E57 fix is committed and tested but the feedback loop is entirely dormant in production until a caller is wired in CompoundExecutor or similar
E55-E62 experiment data (41,983 runs in autoresearch.jsonl) is not persisted to SurrealDB journey_point — these experiments call nexus.deliberate() directly, bypassing the telemetry bus
SurrealDB experiment_runs table has 0 records — the HTTP-direct write code was in the lost Gemini worktree and was not reimplemented

Ouroboros fires 320+ HIHO drift warnings on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions (nexus reset between phases = EVO coherence drop triggers healing budget) — should be filtered to production deliberations only

Mycelium synthesized skills don't persist across experiment runs — each experiment creates a local MyceliumRegistry instance; synthesized skills never reach the production CompoundExecutor._mycelium_registry
JEPA learning (E46) confirmed flat at ~0.97-1.00 final_loss in heuristic mode — needs real LLM variance to generate meaningful training signal; requires iGPU ROCm recovery
Retirement criterion is in-memory only — experiments that converged in a previous session are not recognized as retired on restart; needs seeding from autoresearch.jsonl on startup
PR #113 is open and needs review — contains E57 fix, E63/E64 experiments, retirement criterion, and findings doc
E64 multi-cycle compounding experiment is in the schedule but has not yet been observed to complete — predicted to show monotonic consensus growth toward 0.85 over 4 cycles at lr=1.0
Voice→ManifoldEnv action mapping in E52/E53/E54 was validated but these gymnasium experiments were dropped from the schedule due to system memory pressure — deserve revisiting when resources allow
